name: Bases Task Rows
changes: New Task progress view: one row per note with open, done and total tasks and a progress bar.
It also shows the next due date and the number of overdue tasks of each note, and never changes a note.
tip: Select the calendar button on a row to move the task's due date to today, with Pro.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Task Rows is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
